title: Quality Management Program: Appeals and Grievances Quality Review Terms
content:
Within **Appeals and Grievances**, referral to the quality improvement committee, the provider's period to respond to a quality inquiry and the confidentiality of peer review findings are set per case type.

| Case type | Referred to the quality improvement committee | Provider's period to respond to a quality inquiry (calendar days) | Peer review findings withheld from the member |
|---|---|---|---|
| Member Grievance | No | 0 (not applicable) | No |
| Quality of Care Grievance | Yes | 14 | Yes |
| Standard Appeal | No | 0 (not applicable) | No |
| Expedited Appeal | No | 0 (not applicable) | No |
| State Fair Hearing | No | 0 (not applicable) | No |
| External Medical Review | No | 0 (not applicable) | No |

Stated as a single term: the Quality of Care Grievance is the one case type referred to the quality improvement committee; on it the provider has 14 calendar days to respond to a quality inquiry and the peer review findings are withheld from the member. On the other five case types there is no committee referral, no provider response period (shown as 0) and no withholding of peer review findings.
